comment: Synthetic eval fixture: scripts/eval_retrieval.py builds these notes into a temporary store. Cases name notes as @key.

notes.title: Deploy the package with install.py
notes.body: Edit the source repo, run the tests, then install.py --plan and --apply-plan to deploy the package.

notes.title: Laptop webcam not detected
notes.body: The webcam vanished from Device Manager; a BIOS reset did not bring it back.

notes.title: Prefer small focused commits
notes.body: Keep each commit small and focused on one change.

notes.title: Daily backups keep seven snapshots
notes.body: The store is zipped once a day and the newest seven snapshots are kept.

notes.title: Obsidian vault sync rules
notes.body: Vault edits to title, tags and body are copied back to canonical notes at session end.

notes.title: Cloud diagrams render elements by role
notes.body: Elements with cloud metadata render by role in SVG, Draw.io and Mermaid output.

notes.title: Maven wrapper from Git Bash builds nothing
notes.body: Running `cmd /c mvnw.cmd` from Git Bash exits 0 and never starts the build; use ./mvnw.

notes.title: Force pushes are banned on main
notes.body: Never run `git push --force` on main; use `git revert`.

source_files.docs/runbook.md:
# Cache Warmup Runbook

## Warmup procedure

Before a release, warm the edge cache by replaying the top 500 URLs from the access log with the warmup tool. The tool throttles itself at 40 requests per second.

## Rollback

If latency doubles after warmup, purge the edge cache and redeploy the previous release.
source_files.docs/adr/0007-queue-choice.md:
# 7. Use RabbitMQ for the job queue

Status: Accepted

## Decision

We chose RabbitMQ over Kafka because jobs need per-message acknowledgement and delayed retry, and the team already operates a RabbitMQ cluster.
source_files.src/scheduler.py:
import datetime

SHARD_LIMIT_MB = 64


def schedule_nightly_compaction(shards):
    """Compaction runs at 02:30 UTC and merges every shard smaller than the shard limit."""
    return [s for s in shards if s.size_mb < SHARD_LIMIT_MB]
